title: How to take advantage of the "magnificent seven" technological actions: from Amazon to Microsoft, our city experts reveal which companies should support and whose glory days have finished
text:
The magnificent seven, the Titans of the technology of the United States, have governed supreme in the stock markets during the last two years, delivering stellar yields. His chiefs previously nerd are now billionaires with great political influence as friends of President Trump.
The fortune of the United States Stock Market has been issued by the seven: Alphabet, owner of Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, whose empire encompasses Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp – Microsoft, semiconductor Colossus Nvidia and Tesla.
There is some dispute over who coined the term Magnificent Seven, based on the western film of the 1960s. The credit has been claimed by Bank of America and Goldman Sachs, among others.
But there is a much greater dispute about whether you must continue to support these businesses, either directly or through your ISA and pension funds.
This is what you need to know now.
The magnificent seven, the Titans of the United States Technology, (from left to right) Jeff Bezos de Amazon, Elon Musk of Tesla, Satya Nadella de Microsoft, Mark Zuckerberg of Meta, Tim Cook, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and Alphabet’s Slundar Pichai from Alphabet’s Sludar
Alphabet Expert Cursing: Buy
Alphabet, then known as Google, was created in 1998 by doctoral students Sergey Brin and Larry Page.
Today, the $ 2.5 billion corporation is a digital advertising giant.
Alphabet has diversified in cloud computing and branched in artificial intelligence (AI) with the launch of its Gemini system.
Recently he presented Willow, a new chip for quantum computing.
The sundar boss Pichai, a strict vegetarian fanatic and Fitness, took the best job in 2019. It has a value of $ 1.3 billion and enjoys an annual salary of $ 8.8 million.
But, despite such movements and Pichai’s management touch, Alphabet’s shares fell this week after disappointing results of the fourth quarter and the announcement that the group would invest $ 75 billion in AI, more than expected.
This commitment underlines the level of competition in the AI ​​supremacy game. However, analysts remain optimistic about Alphabet’s ability to stay at the forefront, qualifying actions as a “purchase.”
Amazon Expert Cursing: Buy
Amazon can be known for its delivery service of the next day, but the most profitable part of the corporation is AWS, Amazon Web Services, the largest supplier in the world of cloud computing services
In 1994, Princeton graduate, Jeff Bezos, created Amazon, in a garage, as a bookseller. Now he is the largest online retailer with a market capitalization of $ 2.5 billion.
However, the most profitable part of the corporation is AWS, Amazon’s web services, the largest supplier in the world of cloud computing services. It has a more than 30 percent participation of this rapid expansion sector in which companies outrve data storage.
Amazon’s investment in the new anthropic company of AI was an attempt to catch up with the acquisition of Openai Microsoft, creator of the popular Chatgpt system.
Bezos retired as executive director in July 2021 and was replaced by former AWS Chief Andy Jassy, ​​but now he is president, with a 9 percent participation in the company.
The founder of Amazon has also enriched shareholders. Anyone who invested £ 1,000 when the company was public in 1997 would now be sitting with £ 2,663,000.
The actions cost $ 229 and experts think they have to increase, despite the indications of a slowdown in this week’s results. Just this week, Swiss Bank UBS runners raised their target price at $ 275.
Apple Expert Cursing: Buy
Anyone who invested £ 1,000 in Apple shares in 1980 when it appeared in the stock market would now have £ 2.5 million
Apple was founded in 1976 by Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak in the suburb of Los Angeles de los Altos, Lo Gidinas, a garage. It followed an extraordinary period of technical innovation and design. The company, which some consider more a group of luxury goods than a technological star, is worth $ 3.6 billion. His ambitions now depend on AI.
The results for the last 2024 quarter revealed that sales continue to be weak in China. However, the global revenues of the three months were $ 124.3 billion, which was higher than the prognosis.
Anyone who invested £ 1,000 in Apple shares in 1980 when it appeared in the stock market would now have £ 2.5 million. In the last 12 months, the shares have increased 20 percent to $ 228 and most analysts qualify for them a ‘purchase’.
Part of this optimism about perspectives is based on the admiration of Tim Cook, Executive Director of Apple. He won $ 75 million last year and increases every day at 5 am to exercise, during which he never looks at his iPhone.
Goal Expert Cursing: Buy
Optimism about the goal of harvesting the benefits of AI has promoted the price of the action by 52 percent higher in the last 12 months to $ 715
When the 19 -year -old Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg established the Facebook social network in 2004, he probably didn’t imagine that he would become a $ 1.7 billion corporation. Nor could I have imagined that, by 2025, its wealth would amount to $ 212 billion.
The company, which changed its name to goal in 2021, also has Instagram and WhatsApp.
In 2025, the emphasis is on AI, in which Zuckerberg is spending billions of dollars.
Aarin Chiekrie, Variable Income Analyst in the Hargreaveos Lansdown investment platform, argues that Meta is ‘well located to boost the growth of AI and continue their domain in the AD and the world of social networks’.
Optimism about the goal of harvesting the benefits of AI has promoted the price of the action by 52 % higher in the last 12 months to $ 715, and almost 1,770 percent from the company’s flotation in 2011.
Despite the agitation caused by the suggestion that the Chinese Deepseek had produced comparable AI models for much less than its US rivals, analysts affirmed their opinion that the shares are a ‘purchase’ with an average objective price of $ 727.
Microsoft Expert Cursing: Buy
Microsoft is now directed by Satya Nadella, a graduate of Trump’s computer engineering and fanatic who attributes her ambition to the gym and telling yourself that she is grateful
Microsoft was founded in 1975 by Bill Gates de Harvard and a couple of friends, in a garage, where else?
Today the company is worth more than $ 3 billion.
In addition to the Windows operating system and the Microsoft Office Suite composed of Excel, PowerPoint and Word, its fief encompasses the Azure cloud computing business, LinkedIn, and a large part of Openai.
Operai developed chatgpt, the best known and most expensive brand in the generative AI, and therefore considered the most endangered by the deep Chinese.
But both can be winners, since now an increase in the demand for products of all kinds is expected.
Microsoft is now directed by Satya Nadella, a graduate of Trump’s computer engineering and fanatic who attributes her ambition to the gym and telling yourself that she is grateful. Microsoft’s actions have had a lower performance than their peers recently, but analysts maintain faith.
The current price of the shares is $ 410. The average objective price is $ 507 and an analyst is betting for $ 650.
Nvidia Expert Cursing: Buy
In 30 years, Nvidia has changed a dark 3D graphics firm for video games to a giant of $ 2.9 billion with a control position in exclusive microchips that feed the generative AI.
The founder and executive director Jensen Huang is betting that the majority of the magnificent Seven will continue to spend generously with their company. However, the assessment of your company has fallen in the midst of panic on Deepseek’s interlomeum.
Nvidia shares have fallen by 6 percent this year to $ 130, although they are still 250 times higher than a decade ago. Analysts are supporting Huang with an average objective price of $ 174.
Tesla Expert Cursing: Hold
Sales, profits and margins of Tesla for the fourth quarter of 2024 were all lower than expected
Tesla is a car manufacturer, but it is in the seven magnificent thanks to the software behind its autonomous vehicles. It has been directed by Elon Musk, its executive director, since 2008 and now the richest man in the world, with a value of $ 434 billion.
It is also the “first friend” of President Trump and Co-Cabeza de Doge, the new Efficiency Department of the United States Government.
So great is its influence, amplified by its property of platform X (previously Twitter), which some investors seem prepared to ignore the most recent setbacks in Tesla.
Sales, profits and margins of the company for the fourth quarter of 2024 were all lower than expected. Musk’s political pronouncements are demonstrating a detour in key European markets such as Germany.
Tesla can also be harmed by the elimination of Biden era policies promoted by electric vehicles.
Even so, the actions have raised 89 percent in the last six months, fed by the hopes of Musk of Humanoid Robots, Robotaxis and Ia to optimize the performance of autonomous vehicles of all kinds.
This disconnection between the figures caused an analyst to comment that Tesla’s actions have “divorced from the foundations”, which may be why the actions are qualified as a “retention” instead of a “purchase.”
Investors cannot feel too hard. Since 2014, the price of the action has increased 24 times to $ 374. Critics, however, are concerned that the wheels are coming out.
